## `FilterSpec` {#dashboard-filterspec}

| key | type | default | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `default` | [`RelativeWindow`](#dashboard-relativewindow) |  | A `date_range`'s selection when the dashboard is opened: a window relative to now, such as `{ last: 7, unit: day }`. It moves as time passes; a viewer can change or clear it. |
| `field` | string | **required** | `dataset.field`. |
| `measure` | string |  | A metric shown beside each value instead of its row count, computed for that value under the rest of the selection (OEE per line). |

## `RelativeWindow` {#dashboard-relativewindow}

Whole periods relative to now: the `last` ones of `unit`, ending with the current one, or `ago` periods before it. `{ last: 7, unit: day }` is today and the six days before it; `{ last: 1, unit: month, ago: 1 }` is last month. Periods start where time grains do (weeks on Monday), in UTC.

| key | type | default | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ago` | integer | `0` |  |
| `last` | integer | **required** |  |
| `unit` | [`WindowUnit`](#dashboard-windowunit) | **required** |  |

## `DimensionRef` {#dashboard-dimensionref}

A dimension: `dataset.field`, or a time field at a grain.

One of:

- string
- object with `field`, `grain`

## `VisualType` {#dashboard-visualtype}

One of:

- `kpi` · `bar` · `line` · `table`
- `filter`: The values of one dimension as a list on the grid. A click selects a value, as in a filter on the rail. It has no metrics.


## `WindowUnit` {#dashboard-windowunit}

Type: `minute` · `hour` · `day` · `week` · `month` · `quarter` · `year`.
